settings.recipe: keydep.finetune (src/commute/keydep.py:100-104), unchanged, as E58 Amendments 3-7 called it through amend3/amend4.train: finetune.ArmAConfig(o_token = the map's table, lr = anchors.FT_LR, batch 32, kl_lambda 1, grad_clip 1, Adam, 300 steps, seed), the update read at checkpoint 30 only (constant rate, and checkpoints draw nothing from the batch generator, so steps 1-30 are E58's)

thresholds.reproduce_rule: per refit state: |r(refit, saved bf16 file) - r(E58's saved step-30 read of the same map and seed)| <= the map's seed range = max - min of E58's three saved step-30 r of that map; a miss stops the job before any other reading (the brief: 'if not, the job stops and that is the result')
thresholds.reproduce_tol_source: computed by run.py from the saved reads named in results/inventory.json; the numbers here are the same values, from experiments/open_pair/results/amend7.json prior_beside_r.<map>.r30
thresholds.reproduce_floor: the path difference between the saved reads and this one: bf16 storage of the update, 1.37e-4 on class map seed 0 (experiments/share_untrained/results/stage0.json e_rows.class_twin_definition_verify), 0 on the fp32 rows; the tightest tolerance (copy, 1.47e-3) is about 10 times that
thresholds.reader_source: E143's filed r_tol and neuron_tol (experiments/holes_fill/results/predictions.json thresholds): each reader reproduces its own saved reading of c3/rank1_s0 through this job (E136 stage1 trained, svd, rotated; E98 cells.json c3_rank1_s0 r_n, r_half; E143 stage1 neuron k64, kmatched, steering pooled, perkey), expected 0 (same code, inputs and card); holes_fill's own stage 0 runs unchanged beside it
thresholds.neuron_r_source: E98's per-state checks (experiments/neuron_r/run.py stage1; predictions.json stage0.identity_tol, settings.telescope_tol)
thresholds.rule_source: E143's filed rule, experiments/holes_fill/rules.py call / wider / compare, unchanged

rule.per_reading_and_pair: holes_fill rules.call on the three seeds per side, reuse = the side built to use an existing ability (rank1, copy, elicit, class_map), new = the other; names as built, no verdict on reuse

readings.neuron_top: wider of TopK k64 and kmatched (rules.wider)

rule.verdict: rules.compare of each reading against the share on the four pairs: rival A if it separates, with the share's sign, at least as many pairs as the share separates; rival B if fewer; no call: inert / unreadable as rules.compare
rule.edge_share_none: added here, before the run: if the share separates none of the four pairs, every reading's verdict is 'no call: the share separates none' (rules.compare would call any reading rival A at 0 >= 0)
rule.do_nothing: a zero update has gain 0 < gain_floor, so every share is nan, every call 'unreadable' and every verdict 'no call: unreadable': it cannot reach rival A

expected.W0_and_do_nothing: every numerator 0 exactly and every share undefined (gain 0); holes_fill stage 0 checks this for TopK and steering, E136 stage 0 and E98 stage 0 for the others, on the same code
expected.reproduce: |r difference| about 1e-4 on every refit state (bitwise training on the L40, as E58 Amendment 3 read a max |difference| of 0 and definition_verify stage 4 reproduced the class maps' held-out P to 4 digits)
expected.saved_weights: reported only: the refit of the 7 kept states equal to them (max |difference| 0 against amend3's fp32 files before the bf16 cast; sha256 equal to definition_verify's bf16 files)

predictions.share_calls_source: E58's saved r30 (final.json share cells): gaps 0.56, 0.39, 0.25 and -0.04 of the gain, seed ranges under 0.05
predictions.verdicts_source: the 24-key versions of the same maps and E54's pairs: E136 untrained no call on open_pair_c3 and open_pair_c3_copy; E98 r_n and r_half no call or opposite there; E143 TopK inert on all seven pairs and fair steering rival B (2 of 6, three opposite)
